title: PR #36990 added the support app's CourseTeamManageAPIView with only IsAuthenticated, without the support-role gate every sibling support view uses, so any learner can probe arbitrary accounts and instructors can read other users' course roles.

findings.explanation: The diff only introduces ORM-based queries (CourseAccessRole.objects.filter, SupportStaffRole().has_user, CourseOverview.objects.all). No raw SQL, extra() calls, or string-interpolated queries appear anywhere in the change.

The change adds a missing authorization gate (_caller_can_manage_course_team) to the GET handler, which previously lacked any access check and allowed any authenticated user to reach it. The gate correctly requires superuser, staff, SupportStaffRole, or an instructor CourseAccessRole before allowing access, and raises PermissionDenied (HTTP 403) otherwise. The companion tests confirm that plain learners now receive 403, closing the account-enumeration path. No IDOR pattern is introduced because user lookups are performed by the view using the authenticated caller's identity, not an unvalidated user-controlled id.
